Devon: Quick proposal — replay harness handshake + sampling protocol to get apples-to-apples parity with prod traces while keeping PII scrubbed. Posting config + notes; want sign-off before we run the cohort perf sweep tomorrow morning.

Maria: high level ok. two quick Qs: 1) where do we store the run_salt for anonymization? 2) how do we guarantee deterministic ordering if extracts come out async from the collector?

Devon: answers: 1) run_salt is generated per-run and only stored in the ephemeral run metadata in the control plane (encrypted). we never persist map from original ids->anon ids. 2) we use a small handshake: collector emits sequence numbers per-trace segment; harness reorders by (trace_id, seq_no) and uses stable sort. determinism_seed = sha256(trace_id + run_salt) so hashing is stable across nodes.

Devon: config snippet (for the harness):
```
sampling:
  strategy: stratified
  cohorts:
    - name: short
      pct: 0.35
    - name: medium
      pct: 0.45
    - name: long
      pct: 0.20
warmup:
  prefix_replay_seconds: 30
determinism:
  seed_expr: "sha256(trace_id + run_salt)"
anonymization:
  method: hash256
  keep_structure: false
```

A.J.: we should also pin kernel selection for the replay runs or at least log kernel decisions per request. differences in kernel (faster attention kernel vs fallback) will skew latency buckets and make parity checks noisy.

Sam: absolutely. either pin kernel_version in the runtime config for the run, or add a per-request header `X-Kernel-Decided: v3.1` and include in parity output. also add KV-warmup behavior: replay prefix requests first, then main requests, same batcher heuristics as production.

Devon: agreed. updated handshake: collector sends header `segment_id`, `seq_no`, `trace_len_est`. harness acknowledges `ack_seq` after enqueuing prefix warmups so we can guarantee ordering without blocking collectors for long.

Maria: sounds good. one more nit: sampling weights must be computed from pre-scrubbed metadata to avoid bias. compute cohort assignment from anonymous stable hash only, but use original metadata distributions during weight derivation (done in the extractor service before purge).

A.J.: noted. also let's include a tiny post-run parity job that compares top-99 latency by bucket, kernel breakdown, and token-per-request distribution. if any delta > 3% we mark the run for manual review.

replay-bot: perf-sweep scheduled: 2026-03-19T06:00Z -> run ID r-20260319-07 (ephemeral run_salt generated). All logs will be uploaded to s3://redwood-replay/r-20260319-07/

Sam: LGTM. I'll add kernel pin + KV warmup flag to the run config now. :thumbsup:

Maria: thanks team — will watch the parity job and ping if anything suspicious shows up.
